invariants.rationale: The method avoids division by zero by returning early if b is zero.

meta.value: Division by zero is checked and handled by returning Integer.MIN_VALUE, so normal division only occurs if b != 0

invariants.rationale: By definition, 'a' as an int is within Integer.MIN_VALUE and Integer.MAX_VALUE.
By definition, 'b' as an int is within integer bounds.
Any int except Integer.MIN_VALUE, which might affect division corner cases, is possible.
